mapper.select: SELECT DATE(o.start_time) AS statDate, COUNT(*) AS checkInCount FROM orders o WHERE DATE(o.start_time) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} - 1 DAY) AND DATE(o.start_time) <= CURDATE() AND o.status IN (1, 2, 3) GROUP BY DATE(o.start_time) ORDER BY statDate

SELECT c.id AS categoryId, c.category_name AS categoryName, COUNT(r.id) AS totalRooms, SUM(CASE WHEN o.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS occupiedRooms FROM category c JOIN room r ON r.category_id = c.id AND r.status = 1 LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.room_id = r.id AND o.status IN (1, 2) AND CURDATE() >= DATE(o.start_time) AND CURDATE() < DATE(o.start_time) + INTERVAL o.days DAY GROUP BY c.id, c.category_name ORDER BY occupiedRooms DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.start_time, '%Y-%m') AS statMonth, IFNULL(SUM(o.money), 0) AS revenue FROM orders o WHERE o.start_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{months} - 1 MONTH) AND o.status IN (1, 2, 3) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.start_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY statMonth

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM room WHERE status = 1) AS totalRooms, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member) AS totalMembers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status IN (1, 2)) AS activeOrders, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appointment WHERE status = 1) AS pendingAppointments, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(money), 0) FROM orders WHERE status IN (1, 2, 3) AND DATE_FORMAT(start_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m')) AS monthRevenue

SELECT c.id AS categoryId, c.category_name AS categoryName, c.price AS price, COUNT(o.id) AS orderCount, IFNULL(SUM(o.money), 0) AS totalRevenue FROM category c LEFT JOIN room r ON r.category_id = c.id AND r.status = 1 LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.room_id = r.id AND o.status IN (1, 2, 3) AND DATE(o.start_time) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} - 1 DAY) GROUP BY c.id, c.category_name, c.price ORDER BY orderCount DESC

SELECT d.statDate, IFNULL(occ.occupiedRooms, 0) AS occupiedRooms, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM room WHERE status = 1) AS totalRooms FROM ( SELECT DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL seq DAY) AS statDate FROM ( SELECT 0 AS seq UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 ) AS days ) d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(o.start_time) AS statDate, COUNT(DISTINCT o.room_id) AS occupiedRooms FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (1, 2) AND DATE(o.start_time) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) AND DATE(o.start_time) <= CURDATE() GROUP BY DATE(o.start_time) ) occ ON d.statDate = occ.statDate ORDER BY d.statDate

SELECT c.id AS categoryId, c.category_name AS categoryName, c.price AS price, c.live_num AS liveNum, c.photo AS photo, c.introduce AS introduce, COUNT(r.id) AS totalRooms, SUM(CASE WHEN o.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS occupiedRooms FROM category c JOIN room r ON r.category_id = c.id AND r.status = 1 LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.room_id = r.id AND o.status IN (1, 2) AND CURDATE() >= DATE(o.start_time) AND CURDATE() < DATE(o.start_time) + INTERVAL o.days DAY GROUP BY c.id, c.category_name, c.price, c.live_num, c.photo, c.introduce ORDER BY c.price ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM room r WHERE r.status = 1 AND r.id NOT IN ( SELECT o.room_id FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN (1, 2) AND CURDATE() >= DATE(o.start_time) AND CURDATE() < DATE(o.start_time) + INTERVAL o.days DAY )
